raw.query: WITH candidate AS (SELECT p.run_id, CASE WHEN p.run_id LIKE 'sweeps:vision_head2k_%' THEN 'steady-head' WHEN p.run_id LIKE 'sweeps:vision_burst1_%' THEN 'burst1' ELSE COALESCE(p.window_name,'unlabelled') END AS window_group, p.policy, p.p50_ms, p.p90_ms, p.p99_ms, p.max_ms, p.n_requests, p.is_current, d.superseded_by FROM provenance.v_pool_latency p JOIN provenance.v_dim d USING (run_id) WHERE p.sla_metric = 'encoder_delay' AND (p.run_id LIKE 'sweeps:vision_head2k_%' OR p.run_id LIKE 'sweeps:vision_burst1_%')) SELECT window_group, COUNT(*) AS row_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_current) AS current_rows, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_current OR superseded_by IS NOT NULL) AS noncurrent_or_superseded_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT policy) AS labelled_policy_count, SUM(n_requests) FILTER (WHERE is_current) AS current_request_denominator, MIN(p50_ms) FILTER (WHERE is_current) AS min_p50_ms, MAX(p50_ms) FILTER (WHERE is_current) AS max_p50_ms, MIN(p90_ms) FILTER (WHERE is_current) AS min_p90_ms, MAX(p90_ms) FILTER (WHERE is_current) AS max_p90_ms, MIN(p99_ms) FILTER (WHERE is_current) AS min_p99_ms, MAX(p99_ms) FILTER (WHERE is_current) AS max_p99_ms, MIN(max_ms) FILTER (WHERE is_current) AS min_max_ms, MAX(max_ms) FILTER (WHERE is_current) AS max_max_ms FROM candidate GROUP BY window_group ORDER BY window_group
raw.observed: steady-head has 6 current rows, 0 noncurrent/superseded rows, 0 labelled policies, and 12000 requests; its p50/p90/p99 ranges are 8.876-25.790 / 52.255-477.953 / 199.110-787.180 ms. burst1 likewise has 6 current rows and 0 labelled policies.
raw.claimed: Under low load the policy changes nothing (steady-head percentiles identical to three decimals); it matters inside bursts.
raw.evidence: v_pool_latency contains no labelled chunk-parallel versus sequential arms, so it cannot support the policy comparison; the available steady-head sweep is not percentile-identical either.
raw.fix: Remove the policy-effect assertion or add matched current steady-head and burst runs that differ only in chunk dispatch mode, then report their per-window percentiles and request denominators.
